command.summary: Log in to Azure. By default, this command logs in with a user account. Azure CLI uses Web Account Manager (WAM) on Windows, and browser-based login on Linux and macOS by default. If WAM or a web browser is not available, Azure CLI will fall back to device code login. [WARNING] Authentication with username and password in the command line is strongly discouraged. Use one of the recommended authentication methods based on your requirements. For more details, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2276314 [WARNING] `--password` no longer accepts a service principal certificate. Use `--certificate` to pass a service principal certificate. To log in with a service principal, specify --service-principal. To log in with a managed identity, specify --identity. For more details, see https://learn.microsoft.com/cli/azure/authenticate-azure-cli.

parameters.name: --allow-no-subscriptions
parameters.help: Support accessing tenants without subscriptions. It's useful to run tenant-level commands, such as 'az ad'.

parameters.name: --certificate
parameters.help: PEM file with key and public certificate.

parameters.name: --claims-challenge
parameters.help: Base64-encoded claims challenge requested by a resource API in the WWW-Authenticate header.

parameters.name: --federated-token
parameters.help: Federated token that can be used for OIDC token exchange.

parameters.name: --password
parameters.help: User password or service principal secret. Will prompt if not given.

parameters.name: --scope
parameters.help: Used in the /authorize request. It can cover only one static resource.

parameters.name: --service-principal
parameters.help: Log in with a service principal.

parameters.name: --skip-sub
parameters.help: Skip the subscription discovery process during login. Requires --tenant. Use with --subscription to fetch a single subscription without listing all.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Subscription ID or name to set as the default. When combined with --skip-subscription-discovery, only this subscription is retrieved via a direct API call (must be a subscription ID, not a name).

parameters.name: --tenant
parameters.help: The Microsoft Entra tenant, must be provided when using a service principal.

parameters.name: --use-cert-sn-issuer
parameters.help: Use Subject Name + Issuer (SN+I) authentication in order to support automatic certificate rolls.

parameters.name: --use-device-code
parameters.help: Use device code flow. Azure CLI will also use this if it can't launch a browser, e.g. in remote SSH or Cloud Shell.

parameters.name: --username
parameters.help: User name or service principal client ID.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --client-id
parameters.help: Client ID of the user-assigned managed identity.

parameters.name: --identity
parameters.help: Log in using managed identity.

parameters.name: --object-id
parameters.help: Object ID of the user-assigned managed identity.

parameters.name: --resource-id
parameters.help: Resource ID of the user-assigned managed identity.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
